result_text: The change is in `LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in two tooltip builders: - **Language blocks** (`addLangInfo`): each repository name is now run through `StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4` before the `(N LOC)` suffix is appended. `acme "shop"` is written as `acme <b>"shop"</b>`, which the browser decodes back to the original text in the tooltip. - **Size distribution table** (`addRepositoriesSection`): same escaping applied to the repository name before the line count. I also added the `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils` import, which the module already uses elsewhere. Counts, LOC values, ordering and layout are unchanged. Verification: `mvn -q -o -pl reports test -Dtest='*Landscape*'` completed with no errors. It produced no surefire reports, so no landscape tests matched and nothing exercised the new escaping. I did not render a report with a `"shop"` repository to check the tooltip in a browser. Nothing is committed.
